entity.name: Osvauld Security Solutions Pvt Limited
entity.description: We're building the future of digital collaboration where privacy isn't a compromise. Osvauld Security Solutions develops open-source, peer-to-peer software that enables people to work together directly without surrendering control of their data to third parties. Our mission is to create tools that put users back in control of their digital lives through self-sovereign identity, end-to-end encryption, and offline-first architecture. Documentation available at docs.osvauld.com.

projects.name: Osvauld Framework
projects.description: A Rust framework for building peer-to-peer applications with built-in privacy, security, and user control. Osvauld enables developers to create offline-first apps without servers or data collection. The framework handles complex networking, encryption, and synchronization using modern technologies like Iroh for P2P networking, QUIC protocol for transport, Sequoia-PGP for encryption, CRDTs for synchronization, and UCAN tokens for authorization. It's designed for trusted circles of users who want to collaborate directly without intermediaries.

projects.name: Livnote
projects.description: A collaborative document editor built on the Osvauld framework, featuring real-time peer-to-peer editing with end-to-end encryption and offline-first design. Livnote allows users to write together while staying private - no accounts needed, no servers storing your documents. It supports rich text editing with Markdown, works completely offline, and syncs automatically when devices reconnect. Your documents are protected with end-to-end encryption and stay under your complete control. The Livnote code resides within the main Osvauld repository.
